protocol.fold_seed: generation seed + 1000 * fold; corpus offsets as in the smoke benchmark
protocol.length: trailing 512 training observations; exact per-slot length matching to each fold's real candidates, so draws are fold-specific
protocol.real_filter: complete-case native_v1 rows only; dropped IDs recorded
